## 3.7.7.2 Sever Codes Generated By VM

<a id="HDRSEVVM"></a>

Your program can get sever codes generated from the CP, CMS, TSAF, or AVS

components on VM. [Table 49](#TBLVMSVAPC) lists these sever codes and some possible causes for each sever code. See [Table 48 in topic 3.7.7.1](#TBLALLSEV) for the APPC error condition that corresponds to each of these APPC/VM sever codes. Your program can also get sever codes from AVS that AVS is just passing along from VTAM or other SNA network component. See [Table 48 in](#TBLALLSEV) [topic 3.7.7.1](#TBLALLSEV) for a list of sever codes you can receive.

**Note:** It is important to note that the possible causes shown for each code may not be an exhaustive list.

<a id="VMSVAPC"></a>

Table 49. Sever Codes Generated by VM

| Sever | Possible Causes | CodeX'0110' The local AVS had prob |
| --- | --- | --- |
